observations.why: The speaker enacts a decisional authority by declaring adoption as settled fact, performing the relational move of authoritative pronouncement rather than proposal or consultation.
The decision is justified through proportional cost-benefit framing — quantified performance gain as the rationale for the database choice — enacting market-pricing relational logic.
